definitions.gloss: party leader, head of a political party
definitions.explanation: The leader or chairperson of a political party. Used in news and political discourse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{党首|とうしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: A new party leader was chosen.

examples.japanese: {党首|とうしゅ}⟦{討論|とうろん}→討論：05100_touron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The party leaders' debate was broadcast on television.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{党首|とうしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}した→批判する：21993_hihansuru⟧。
examples.english: The opposition party leader harshly criticized the government's policies.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term used in political reporting and discussion. In Japan, different parties use different titles for their leaders — ⟦{総裁|そうさい}→総裁：13890_sousai⟧ (president) for the LDP, ⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧ (representative) for some opposition parties — but {党首|とうしゅ} is a general term applicable to any party leader.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {党首|とうしゅ}⟦{討論|とうろん}→討論：05100_touron⟧: party leaders' debate
- {党首|とうしゅ}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: party leadership election
- {党首|とうしゅ}⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧: meeting of party leaders
